# Compute neighborhood averages
neighborhood_averages = {}
for borough in no2_data['borough']:
    neighbors = adjacency_path[adjacency_path['borough'] == borough]['neighbor'].tolist()
    neighborhood_averages[borough] = no2_data[no2_data['borough'].isin(neighbors)]['NO2_value'].mean()

# Apply the ITERATIVE-R method
def iterative_r(borough, neighborhood_average):
    # Calculate the citywide average
    citywide_average = no2_data['NO2_value'].mean()
    
    # Calculate the neighborhood average
    neighborhood_average = neighborhood_averages[borough]
    
    # Calculate the test statistic
    test_statistic = (no2_data[no2_data['borough'] == borough]['NO2_value'].values[0] - neighborhood_average) / (citywide_average - neighborhood_average)
